I could've gotten away with purchasing a size 9, but I decided to keep them because it's winter season and they are both non-slip and waterproof. They will work great with thick socks. So far, I have worn them several times for hours at a time. On one particular day I did over 11,000 steps, and I must say I have absolutely no issues at all. They are comfortable and chic and goes with everything. Every shoe in my closet no matter how comfortable they are, I always have some minor issues after several hours of wear, but not with these boots. I just examined them while writing this review and there is no abnormal wear or tear or scuff marks. I have them about 3 weeks now and wear them at least 3-4 times per week, plus they are carrying around a lot of body weight. For the price I believe you can't lose. I'm going to buy another colour but will go with size 9 this time because I believe they will eventually stretch. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

top_reviews.title: Very cute but runs big
top_reviews.text: The shoes are very cute and comfortable. Unfortunately they were way too big for me. I ordered a size 7 and they fit my sisters feet who wears a size 8. Considering re-purchasing them and going to size down.
